# Home Todo Count API and Bug 6959 Fix
The real taskCount API, account-dependent count semantics, and the code fix pattern for the 防汛C端 mobile H5 home page todo card (ZenTao bug 6959).

## API Contract
- `GET /api/v2.0/flowable/task/taskCount` returns `{"code":200,"data":{"todoNum":...,"finishedNum":...,"myProcessNum":...}}`; the todo field is `todoNum`
- `/api/v2.0/flowable/task/todoTaskList` `total` matches `todoNum` (both 4940 live for the deploy_env-huishan-g-dev account)
- APIs sit behind nginx at `/api/v2.0/...` and need a token; login uses an AES-encrypted password plus captcha from `/api/v2.0/code`, which shows arithmetic questions (e.g. "5+5=?", "2*8=?") that expire quickly

## Count Semantics
- The todo count is account-dependent: the expected "真实14" (real 14) came from the QA screenshot account; the live test account shows 4940
- The fix must read the real `todoNum` field and never hardcode a fixed value
- Expected layout (G-end screenshot): one count, icon and title on the same row, list rows below, no "共X项待办需处理" hint

## Fix and Status
- Four code changes: new taskCount API wrapper, fetchHome switched to real count with fallback, template refactor, scoped SCSS aligned with news-head
- Pre-edit baseline build passed (exit 0); post-edit `npm test` all green (portal 11/11) and build passed
